intro.title: Left-hand scale
intro.text: The left hand goes up 5 4 3 2 1, then finger 3 crosses over the thumb: 3 2 1. Coming down, the thumb passes under finger 3.

intro.title: Both hands
intro.text: Bars 5–8 play the scale in both hands, an octave apart. The thumbs cross at different moments, so go slowly: try 50 BPM in Practice.
